SECTION: Chapter 3 | Article 3. Registration. Registration is open to new and old students who have satisfied the admission requirements. For on-site registration, students should enroll at the Office of the Registrar and register only in those subjects approved by the Registration Adviser/Program Coordinator/College Dean, as evidenced by their initials on the registration form. Whenever applicable, online registration may be used in line with its effectivity as endorsed by the University Registrar.
the academic load rules. Cross-registration may be allowed if there is a conflict in schedule and/or non-offering of the subject in the university.

4.2. From Another Institution. A student registered from another institution and wishes to cross-register in LSPU must present a registrar's written permit. The written permit should state the total number of units for which the student is registered and the subjects that he is authorized to take them at LSPU. Admission is subject to the approval of the LSPU registrar.

4.3. To Another Institution. A student who wishes to cross-register in another institution should seek permission /approval from the college dean where he is enrolled, and the campus registrar on the subject/course and number of units to be cross enrolled to earn credits on the subject/course.

SECTION: Chapter 5 | Article 3. Institutional Student Programs and Services. These are programs and activities the University offers to facilitate the delivery of essential services to the students. It refers to the services and programs designed to proactively provide for the basic health, food, shelter, and safety concerns of students including students with special needs and disabilities.
Article 3. Institutional Student Programs and Services. These are programs and activities the University offers to facilitate the delivery of essential services to the students. It refers to the services and programs designed to proactively provide for the basic health, food, shelter, and safety concerns of students including students with special needs and disabilities.

Sec. 1. Admission and Testing Services

1.1. Recruit prospective college students through career information.

1.2. Administer college entrance test and conduct intake interview for all incoming university students and transferees as a process for admission.

1.3. Prepare and update testing materials.

1.4. Keep files and records systematically.

1.5. Interpret and evaluate college entrance test results and post them on the bulletin board.

1.6. Strictly follow the admission policies of the university.

1.7. Assist incoming college students, facilitate admission requirements and similar documents.

1.8. Recommend alternatives/options, if necessary, for students who failed the admission requirements.

1.9. Administer psychological tests for students who have special cases.

Sec. 2.

trace.answer_for_eval:
The documents needed for enrollment are:

For New Students/Transferees:
1. Enrolment Slip from Admission Office
2. Original Certificate of Good Moral Character
3. Original Report Card (for New Students Only)
4. Photocopy of PSA Birth Certificate/Marriage Contract for Married Female Students
5. Original/authenticated Form 137 (for New Accredited DOH Students Only)
6. Medical slip/Certificate from LSPU Medical Clinic
7. Transcript of Records/Copy of Grades for Client Evaluation purposes (for Transferees only)
8. 2 pcs/ 2x2 picture
9. Original Certificate of Transfer (for Transferees only)
10. 1 pc. Long brown envelope

For Old Students:
1. Clearance

Additional requirements for freshmen (from the admission requirements):
- Report Card (DepEd Form 138)
- Permanent Record (DepEd Form 137)
- Physical, medical, and drug testing examinations certified by a government physician
- Certificate of Good Moral Character
- Three (3) latest 2x2 pictures
- Photocopy of authenticated birth certificate/marriage certificate issued by PSA (for married female students)
- Alternative Learning System (ALS)/Philippine Educational Placement Test (PEPT) results (if applicable)
